description: This PHP class 'FilterInterpreter' interprets filter structures for the SuiteCRM JSON API, converting filter definitions into SQL clauses or filter objects, and handling different filter types such as pre-made filters, ID filters, and attribute-based filters. It manages external dependencies like operators, validators, and interpreters, and includes methods for processing filter logic, including custom fields and table name adjustments.

classes.name: FilterInterpreter
classes.description: A class that interprets filter structures for the SuiteCRM JSON API, converting them into SQL WHERE clauses or filter objects, and managing filter operators, validation, and custom field handling.

methods.name: isFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure corresponds to a pre-made filter name.

methods.name: isFilterById
methods.description: Checks if the filter structure is an ID-based filter.

methods.name: isFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Determines if the filter structure is attribute-based, excluding ID filters.

methods.name: getFilterByPreMadeName
methods.description: Converts a pre-made filter name into an SQL filter string.

methods.name: getFilterById
methods.description: Converts an ID filter structure into a filter object.

methods.name: getFilterByAttributes
methods.description: Converts attribute-based filter structures into SQL WHERE clauses.

methods.name: toSqlFilter
methods.description: Builds a SQL filter string for a specific field and operator.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Retrieves the operator object corresponding to a string operator.

methods.name: isCustomField
methods.description: Checks if a field is a custom field for a given module.

methods.name: toCustomTable
methods.description: Converts a table name to its custom version (appends '_cstm' if not present).
